traceability.notes:
All functional and technical requirements from docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md are implemented and covered by automated tests.
• The new @supports annotation format is parsed and validated for syntax and structure by `valid-annotation-format`, with comprehensive tests for valid/mixed usage and all specified error cases. • Deep validation that each @supports requirement ID exists in its referenced story file is implemented by `valid-req-reference`, including proper error messages that include the story path and support for requirement ID reuse across multiple stories. • The presence rules `require-story-annotation` and `require-req-annotation` have been updated so that a nearby @supports annotation is sufficient to satisfy story/requirement presence, while existing @story/@req-only behavior remains unchanged and fully tested. • Mixed usage of @story/@req and @supports in the same comment/function/file is explicitly supported and verified by tests. • Documentation specific to @supports (especially for format validation and deep requirement validation) exists and is aligned with the implementation, including migration guidance showing how to move from single-story @story/@req annotations to multi-story @supports.
There are some residual mentions of '@implements' in legacy documentation text, but runtime behavior, tests, and the main rule docs all operate exclusively on @supports, in line with ADR 011 and the story's ADR note. Given the strong test coverage, traceability annotations, and alignment between spec and behavior, this story is fully implemented and verified.
